page.overview:
Who is Douglas Drexler?

Douglas "Doug" Drexler was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2328, the ferried him from Gamma Trianguli VI to Gothos Space Center. His passenger manifest was accessed by Lieutenant Commander Data aboard the in 2370 by reviewing this data in the commercial transport database. (, okudagram)

He was a captain in the 2360s. He was the commander of the . He was mentioned in the Personnel Status Report of Lieutenant Keith G. Rocha. (, okudagram)

In 2372, he was listed as a Systems Management officer on the dedication plaque of the . (, )
